intro: The Filled Tourmaline Phial holds enchanted waters drawn from the moonwell bordering the Pools of Arlithrien in southern Teldrassil. Collected at the request of Corithras Moonrage, the water serves as part of an effort to monitor the health and balance of the growing World Tree.

p: The Tourmaline Phial is prepared specifically to draw water from the moonwell located southeast of the road to Darnassus, on the shores of the Pools of Arlithrien. Gathering water from this shrine has become fraught with peril due to the sudden aggression of the Gnarlpine furbolgs, peaceful neighbors who have rapidly deteriorated into violent madness. Corithras Moonrage tasks travelers with braving the hostile groves to secure this water, aiming to diagnose the deepening corruption unsettling the land.
